## UI Consistency Audit — Run 112 complete

**Result: 0 defects found, 0 fixes required, 0 regressions. Build PASS (`npx vite build`, exit 0). No app file changed.**

### Audits 1–7 — all PASS, converged for the 16th consecutive run
One aggregating 19-route sweep covered all seven:

| Audit | Result |
|---|---|
| **1 Icons** | 43 imports, **all** `24/outline`; 0 solid/foreign; only the 2 documented map `<svg>`s. Runtime: **2,206 SVGs, 0 foreign viewBoxes** |
| **2 Buttons** | 22 page-level classes; 9 with geometry variants, **all 9** documented deliberate (segmented controls, active states, `.row-actions`, `clamp()` artifacts) |
| **3 Headers** | `.topbar.glass` at **exactly 56px** + correct `<h1>` on 19/19 |
| **4 Sidebar** | 18 links / 18 icons / 42px / gaps `[0,30,8]` / 1 `.is-active` on 19/19 (`/alerts` = 0, the documented orphan route) |
| **5 Forms** | **0** native `<select>`, **0** `input[type=date]` app-wide; all `.form-input` variants documented deliberate |
| **6 Spacing** | Consistent within pages; the fractional Dashboard values are the documented Tailwind-rem-vs-14px-root systemic item |
| **7 Modals** | 0 stray overlays at rest on all 19 |

### The real work: both remaining open UI leads swept and closed
- **Tailwind-utilities layer** (13 routes / 409 elements / 322 probes) — the `utilities` layer genuinely beats `@layer base` at *any* specificity, but it fires in only three places and **all three are intended**: arbitrary-value utilities over the global button reset (`index.css:91`), the documented `!gap-0`/`pb-0` sites, and `sticky` over `.glass`. **0 kills.**
- **mapbox-gl / Google Maps unlayered-vendor layer** (2 routes / 212 elements / **1,622 probes**) — report-only per charter. All 4 app rules targeting vendor selectors are alive; the only vendor hits are Google Maps styling its own controls. **0 kills.**

### All three "findings" were bugs in my own harness, not the app
Worth flagging since this is the recurring pattern on this codebase: a probe that sets `transition:none` before reading **cannot then audit `transition`**; a flat rule regex **hoisted the `@media (max-width:768px)` mobile block out of its query** (4 convincing false positives whose app selectors had *higher* specificity than the utilities they "lost" to); and re-asserting a shorthand clobbers a longhand declared after it in the same block (`body` `:83-87`, `.sidebar__user` `:399-403`). Each is recorded in the gotchas so the next run doesn't repeat them.

### Also done
- Committed `47d2d13` — s1 capped mid-work and left a **correct** `max(updated_at)` snapshot fix in `.qa-r100-sweep.mjs` uncommitted. The "git status is a first-action" rule has now recovered work on three separate nights.
- Report written to **both** `C:/tmp/ui-audit-results.txt` and bash-`/tmp/ui-audit-results.txt`, replacing the stale Run 94 file. **`/tmp/api-test-results.txt` and `/tmp/frontend-test-results.txt` are still stale — s5 must date-check those.**
- Memory updated (`MEMORY.md`, `overnight_resume.md`, `qa_standing_gotchas.md`), backups moved out of the memory dir, UTF-8 verified intact.

**One recommendation for you:** this charter is exhausted as a defect-finding instrument — the seven audits now cost a single tool call. Both s1 and s2 capped at `max_turns` again tonight (s1 for the 5th run running). I'd suggest reassigning the s3 slot, and raising the s1/s2 turn budgets or narrowing their charters.
